input.body:
File: docs/API.md

The API documentation for the /reports endpoints should include field limits, such as the maximum number of categories, maximum length for report names, and the maximum number of schedule recipients.

text:
The issue #4612 concerns the absence of documentation for field limits in the Reports section of the API reference. The `docs/API.md` file describes the Reports API but indeed lacks details on limits such as the maximum number of recipients or the maximum length of a field like the report name. 

This issue is about updating the documentation to include these constraints so that users can validate their data before sending requests.

I will label this as a "docs" issue and proceed accordingly.
